Know what you’re comparing

The 2020–2024 American Community Survey is a five-year snapshot, released January 2026. These are area-level survey estimates—not live listings, appraisals, individual sales, or 2026 prices.

Read the uncertainty

Context, not a verdict.

Published estimatesEligible for this chart. Sampling error means nearby values may not differ meaningfully.
Open-ended intervalsShown as ≥ or ≤ in the table. A capped value is not a precise price or rank.
Unavailable estimatesKept as missing, not replaced with zero. Small communities may have limited samples.

± figures are published margins of error at 90% confidence. They are not forecasts or a guarantee of current prices.

Open source · Python + SQL

Trace every number.

Independent project. Not affiliated with the U.S. Census Bureau.

Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020–2024 ACS 5-year Summary File. All 58 counties, 1,618 census places and California’s own statewide estimate. Snapshot retrieved October 2026. Updates are published snapshots, not live feeds.

What is measured: B25077 owner-occupied home values; B25064 gross rents including utilities; B25071 median rent-to-income percentages; B19013 annual household incomes in 2024 dollars; B01003 population.

What is not measured: Sale transactions, asking rents, home size, bedrooms or investment returns. The former simulated records and unsupported price-per-square-foot calculations have been removed. County and place data overlap; do not sum them. Incorporated cities and unincorporated census places appear together.

Quality: Python checks source-file hashes and geography coverage. SQLite joins by Census GEO_ID and handles Census special values. The browser displays that exact output. No imputation, median-of-medians, or household-level inference.
